title: THE FREQUENCY BENEATH · The glow, measured
venue: private · after a paperback found in the library's return cart · Box 26
logline: The ridge at night drawn twice: once as it looks, and once as a plot — brightness against hours — with the glow's curve rising every night at the same minute and the curve for the year drawn beneath, rising slowly since 2009. The page has the numbers and doesn't letter them. It letters one word on the axis and then crosses it out.

panels.composition: The top half: a wooded ridge at night with a warm glow above it; the bottom half: two hand-drawn plots, one of brightness against the hours of a night rising to a peak, one of brightness against years rising slowly from a marked point, an axis label written and crossed out.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, the top half of a page showing a wooded ridge at night with a warm glow above it and the bottom half showing two hand-drawn line plots, one rising to a nightly peak and one rising slowly across years from a marked point, an axis label crossed out, no words legible
image.notes: The crossed-out word: reserved. The marked point on the years axis is 2009 (the Lanes).

art.line: the private line, but ruled: graph paper, waveforms, spectrogram bands drawn by hand
art.palette: ochre and slate; the trace in one warm color

notes: Letters one word and crosses it out.
